Operations.Name: StaticrouteCreate
Operations.Description:
Create a Static Route.

Address families of `gateway` and `destination` should match when creating a static route.

`description` is an optional attribute for any notes regarding the static route.

Arguments.Name: data
Arguments.Description: Configuration for the new static route.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the static route to delete.
